Clause 6.2.4.2 step 3: "The MBS Client shall select an MBS AS instance repair URL randomly from the list of object‌Repair‌BaseLocators if present in the ObjectRepair object defined in table 5.2.8-1."

cases.case: availabilityInfos: mbsServiceAreas and mbsFSAId
cases.what: Writes the target service areas and the FSA identifier of the MBS Distribution Session.

cases.case: availabilityInfos: nrParameters for a broadcast session
cases.what: No NR frequency band or ARFCN is ever written.

cases.case: availabilityInfos: nrRedCapUEInfo
cases.what: nrRedCapUeInfo of the MBS Distribution Session is not carried into the announcement.

cases.case: securityDescription
cases.what: No SecurityDescription is written; the MBSF has no MBSSF interaction.

noted: Content types for applicationServiceDescriptions are derived from the file extension of each acquisition identifier, falling back to application/octet-stream; TS 29.580 ObjectDistrMethInfo carries no content type to copy.

cases.case: id unique per scheduled instance
cases.what: Every Service Schedule Description of an ingest session carries the same id, the ingest session identifier, so several scheduled windows share one id.

cases.case: version increases when the instance changes
cases.what: Keeps the version of a window that is unchanged across an update and gives a changed or new window a new version.

cases.case: start and stop for a time window
cases.what: Writes start and stop in ISO 8601 UTC for each active period.

cases.case: repetitionRule (startTime, duration, repetitionInterval)
cases.what: Writes the provisioned repetition rule instead of start and stop.

cases.case: cancelled
cases.what: The MBSF never writes cancelled in a Service Schedule Description: the announcement schema the build pins (5G_APIs TSG111-Rel18, version 2.1.0, from TS 26.517 V18.3.0) has no such property, so a cancelled instance cannot be signalled.

cases.case: SDP per RFC 8866, one per Distribution Session, served as application/sdp
cases.what: Writes one SDP document per MBS Distribution Session with v, o, s, t and m lines and labels it application/sdp.

cases.case: a=mbs-servicetype present, at session level, once
cases.what: Adds a single session-level mbs-servicetype attribute naming broadcast or multicast from the MBS User Service type.

cases.case: TMGI encoded as a decimal of octets 3 to 8
cases.what: Appends the TMGI as a decimal built from the MBS Service ID followed by the MCC and MNC nibbles in TS 24.008 octet order, and leaves it out while no MBS Service ID is assigned.

cases.case: t-line a superset of the schedule, or 0 0 without one
cases.what: Sets the t-line to the earliest start and latest end of the active periods, or to zero when none is provisioned.

cases.case: Service-language per media not used
cases.what: Writes no a=lang attribute.

cases.case: FLUTE/UDP media line, flute-tsi and source-filter for the Object Distribution Method
cases.what: Declares FLUTE/UDP, one session-level flute-tsi and a source-filter for an object session, and plain UDP without flute-tsi for a packet session.

cases.case: Source address for a Broadcast session without SSM
cases.what: Takes the source and destination from the configured broadcast distribution addresses that the Nmb9 flow uses, and writes no announcement when they are not configured.

cases.case: FEC declaration and redundancy level from the FEC configuration
cases.what: Declares FEC-declaration with the encoding ID taken from fecScheme and FEC-redundancy-level from fecOverHead only when FEC is configured.

cases.case: Packet Distribution Method SDP
cases.what: Writes the same session-level mbs-servicetype and a plain UDP media line; the restrictions of clause 7.2.3.1 (no bearer mode, QoE, ROHC or alternative TMGI) are met because none is written.

cases.case: Content-Type multipart/related
cases.what: Builds the bundle as multipart/related with an RFC 2046 boundary.

cases.case: type parameter set to the User Service Descriptions media type
cases.what: Sets the type parameter of the multipart entity to application/3gpp-mbs-user-service-descriptions+json.

cases.case: Root body part first, no start parameter
cases.what: Adds the root part before any dependent part and sets no start parameter.

cases.case: Content-Location on every other body part
cases.what: Gives each file part a bare Content-Location with its relative path, encoding it only when it holds characters a URI cannot carry.

cases.case: All dependent resources included
cases.what: Includes the Session Description document of every MBS Distribution Session of the matching ingest session.

cases.case: A User Service with several active ingest sessions
cases.what: Only the first ingest session with an available bundle describes a User Service at MBS-5, so the Distribution Sessions of any other active ingest session are not announced there.

requirements.name: User Service Announcement Channel provisioning

spec.locator: clause 5.3A steps 1 to 6; clause 5.4 step 2B; TS 26.517 V18.6.0 clause 5.3.2

cases.case: OBJECT_CAROUSEL MBS Distribution Session of the Object Distribution Method
cases.what: Provisions the channel as an OBJECT Distribution Session in CAROUSEL mode.

cases.case: TMGI allocated for the channel (step 1)
cases.what: The channel uses the configured SSM addresses as its MBS Session identifier and requests no TMGI.

cases.case: MBS Session created at the MB-SMF (step 2)
cases.what: Creates the MBS Session before asking the MBSTF for the Distribution Session.

cases.case: Nmb2 create with a single object acquisition identifier (step 3)
cases.what: Creates the channel at the MBSTF with PUSH acquisition and the single acquisition identifier "carousel", retrying when the MBSTF does not answer.

cases.case: Subscription to MBSTF status (step 4)
cases.what: Subscribes through the distSessionSubscription of the Nmb2 create, as for any Distribution Session.

cases.case: Object manifest pushed to the MBSTF whenever it changes (push acquisition)
cases.what: POSTs the object manifest, labelled application/3gpp-mbs-object-manifest+json;version="Rel17", to the ingest base URL and push identifier whenever its content changes.

cases.case: Manifest lists every announcement bundle and asks for update polling
cases.what: Lists one bundle per ingest session with an available announcement, each with the configured repetition interval and keep-updated interval.

cases.case: Channel active only while there is something to announce
cases.what: Asks the MBSTF for ACTIVE while at least one bundle is available and for INACTIVE otherwise.

noted: The bundle URLs the MBSTF is told to fetch at MBS-11 use plain HTTP on a private path of the co-located MBS AF.

requirements.name: User Service Description retrieval API at MBS-5 (co-located MBS AF)

cases.case: Base path {apiRoot}/3gpp-mbs-user-service-discovery/v1/
cases.what: Serves the API under /3gpp-mbs-user-service-discovery/v1/ on the co-located MBS AF server.

cases.case: Discover with service-class
cases.what: Filters the User Services by servClass equal to the service-class query parameter.

cases.case: Discover with profile
cases.what: Filters on a conformance profile listed by a Distribution Session Description; since the MBSF never writes conformanceProfiles, a profile query matches nothing.

cases.case: Discover without any query parameter is an error
cases.what: Answers 400 when neither service-class nor profile is given.
cases.locator: clause 9.2.2, table 9.2.2-1, row Discover User Service Descriptions

cases.case: Discover with no match
cases.what: Answers 204 with no body when nothing matches.
cases.conflict: TS 26.517 V18.6.0 table 9.2.2-1: "A User Service Descriptions Bundle (see clause 9.2.3.1) is returned containing User Service Descriptions matching all of the specified filtering criteria and their dependent resources, which may be empty if none match all of the criteria." TS26517_MBSUserServiceAnnouncement.yaml (Annex A.2.1), GET /user-service-descriptions, responses: "204: No Matches Found"; and a User Service Descriptions document requires at least one userServiceDescriptions item (minItems: 1), so an empty bundle cannot be valid.
cases.locator: clause 9.2.2, table 9.2.2-1, row Discover User Service Descriptions

cases.case: Retrieve by externalServiceId: 200 or 404
cases.what: Returns the bundle of the User Service with that external service identifier and 404 when none has it.

cases.case: GET only
cases.what: Answers any other method with 405.

cases.case: Strong ETag and Last-Modified on responses
cases.what: Sends a strong entity tag computed over the bundle content and a Last-Modified from the newest part.

cases.case: Cache-Control max-age on responses
cases.what: No Cache-Control header is sent.

cases.case: Conditional GET with If-None-Match and If-Modified-Since
cases.what: Answers 304 with the validators when If-None-Match matches, or when If-Modified-Since is not older than Last-Modified and no If-None-Match is given.

cases.case: HTTP/1.1 endpoint with TLS supported
cases.what: Serves HTTP/1.1 through libmicrohttpd without any TLS option.

cases.case: Server header MBSAF-<host>/<version>
cases.what: Sends a Server header "MBSAF (<HTTP library> <version>; <comment>)": the MBSAF token is present but without the hyphen and host name or a product version giving the 3GPP release.

noted: The MBS AF also serves each ingest session bundle under the private path /x-5gmag-service-announcements/v1/user-data-ingest-session/, which the announcement channel uses.

requirements.name: Announcement passed back to the Application Provider (MBS-1)

cases.case: URL of the bundle given to the Application Provider for PASSED_BACK
cases.what: No URL attribute can be given on the session, since mbsUserServiceAnmtUrlExt is not defined in TS 29.580 (noted). The User Service Description is put inline in mbsUserServiceAnmt for PASSED_BACK, and the USER_SER_AD notification carries the bundle URL only when the User Service Announcement Channel is deployed.

cases.case: mbsUserServiceAnmtUrl for VIA_MBS_5
cases.what: The attribute is never set.
cases.locator: TS 29.580 V18.8.0 clause 6.2.6.2.2, table 6.2.6.2.2-1, row mbsUserServiceAnmtUrl

cases.case: statusAddInfo of USER_SER_AD carries the bundle URL
cases.what: Puts the bundle URL in statusAddInfo of the USER_SER_AD event, for a service carried on the announcement channel.

cases.case: Server header MBSF at MBS-1
cases.what: The bundle is served by the co-located MBS AF server, whose Server header is "MBSAF (<HTTP library>; <comment>)": it names MBSAF rather than the MBSF product token, with no host name or version.

noted: TS 26.517 V18.6.0 clause 8A.2 names "the mbsUserServiceAnmtUrlExt attribute of the MBSUserDataIngSession data type, per clause 6.2.6.2.2 of TS 29.580", but neither TS 29.580 V18.8.0 nor the V18.7.0 the build pins defines that attribute; its row mbsUserServiceAnmtUrl applies to the VIA_MBS_5 mode only. This is a missing definition, not a contradiction, so it is noted rather than judged; the clause's other route (statusAddInfo of USER_SER_AD) is judged.

features.name: MBS Client
features.summary: The client acquires announcements from the announcement channel and by MBS-5 discovery, activates and deactivates reception by external service identifier within the announced schedule, receives the Object Distribution Method and serves received objects to the application, and runs post-session repair; retrieval by identifier, User-Agent headers, packet distribution and MBS-10 key retrieval are absent, and repair differs in its request pattern and end-of-session detection.

requirements.name: User Service Description acquisition

cases.case: Retrieval from the MBS AF at MBS-5 by external service identifier (GET .../3gpp-mbs-user-service-discovery/v1/user-service-descriptions/{externalServiceId})
cases.what: The client never retrieves an announcement at MBS-5 by external service identifier: the Retrieve request is written but nothing calls it, and activation by identifier searches only services already learned.

cases.case: Discovery by query parameter service-class
cases.what: The Discover request is sent as GET {apiRoot}/3gpp-mbs-user-service-discovery/v1/user-service-descriptions with the service-class query parameter, and the returned bundle replaces the list of known services.
cases.locator: TS 26.517 V18.6.0 clause 9.2.2, table 9.2.2-2, row Service class

cases.case: Discovery is never sent without a query parameter
cases.what: The local API runs a Discover only when the application supplies a service-class value, and the Discover request always carries that parameter.
cases.locator: TS 26.517 V18.6.0 clause 9.2.2, table 9.2.2-1, row Discover User Service Descriptions

cases.case: Acquisition from the User Service Announcement Channel at MBS-4-MC (carousel objects)
cases.what: The client joins the announcement channel from a pre-configured service announcement USD or a configured fallback, and every received object whose content type is multipart/related is fed into the list of known services.

cases.case: USD passed in by the MBS-Aware Application (MBS-8 route, 26.502 clause 5.4 C)
cases.what: The application-facing API has no operation that accepts an MBS User Service Announcement as a parameter; only an external service identifier can be passed.

cases.case: Root body part of the multipart/related bundle taken as the User Service Descriptions document
cases.what: The bundle is split with a MIME parser and the first body part is parsed as the User Service Descriptions JSON document, on both the MBS-5 and the MBS-4-MC paths.

cases.case: Other body parts matched to the Session Description by Content-Location
cases.what: A bundled Session Description is looked up by exact Content-Location match only when sessionDescriptionLocator is not an http(s) URL; for an absolute locator, which table 5.2.4-1 requires, the bundle is not searched and the Session Description is fetched over the network instead, and a relative Content-Location is not resolved against the base URI before matching.

cases.case: User Service Descriptions document read according to the schema of clause A.2 (userServiceDescriptions array required)
cases.what: A root document without the userServiceDescriptions wrapper is also accepted and read as a single User Service Description object, which the schema does not allow.

cases.case: USD document media type application/3gpp-mbs-user-service-descriptions+json handled
cases.what: The root part is parsed as a User Service Descriptions document whatever its declared type, and a bare pre-configured document is ingested under this media type; the type's version and profiles parameters are not inspected.

cases.case: Version rule: higher version overwrites; absent version means the latest delivered document overwrites
cases.what: A bundle with a version lower than the highest already merged is ignored, a bundle without a version always replaces matching services, and services are merged by shared service identifier.
cases.locator: TS 26.517 V18.6.0 clause 5.2.2, table 5.2.2-1, row version

cases.case: User-Agent with product identifier MBSFClient and release suffix at MBS-5
cases.what: The MBS-5 requests set no User-Agent header.

cases.case: No conditional revalidation before the indicated time-to-live
cases.what: No conditional GET is ever sent, so a User Service Description is never revalidated before its time-to-live; it is not refreshed afterwards either.

cases.case: HTTP version at MBS-5 chosen among those the MBS AF must offer
cases.what: Each MBS-5 request is tried over cleartext HTTP/2 first and repeated over HTTP/1.1 if that fails, so an MBS AF offering only the mandatory HTTP/1.1 is reached.

requirements.exists: A Retrieve request to user-service-descriptions/{externalServiceId} exists in the client but has no caller.
noted: The optional profile query parameter of Discover is never sent; only service-class is used.
A Discover replaces the whole list of known services, so services learned from the announcement channel are dropped until the channel delivers them again.
When strict MIME parsing finds no parts, the bundle is split again on the raw boundary string, accepting a bundle whose delimiter lines do not match its declared boundary parameter.
No Accept-Encoding is sent and a gzip Content-Encoding on individual body parts is not decoded.
The default MBS-5 API root is cleartext http; clause 8.2.1.1 says a client should prefer HTTPS where the option exists.
The version used for the overwrite rule is tracked once for all bundles ingested, not per announcement source.

A retrieved User Service Description is never refreshed or revalidated. TS 26.517 V18.6.0 clause 8.2.3.4 obliges servers (ETag, Last-Modified, max-age, conditional requests) and only discourages early revalidation by clients ("API clients should not attempt to revalidate their cached copy of a resource using a conditional GET request before the indicated time-to-live period has elapsed."); no sentence read obliges an MBSF Client to refresh, so this is a scope limit, not a verdict.

requirements.name: MBS User Service reception activation and termination

cases.case: Activation identified by an external service identifier, locating an announcement obtained from the announcement channel (26.502 clause 5.4 step 2B)
cases.what: The application activates a service by external service identifier through the local API, and the client finds the matching service among announcements already received.

cases.case: Activation by external service identifier where the announcement must first be obtained at MBS-5 (26.502 clause 5.4 step 2A)
cases.what: When the identifier is not among services already learned, activation fails instead of retrieving the announcement at MBS-5 (see US-C01-client).

cases.case: Activation with a full announcement passed as a parameter
cases.what: No activation operation accepts an announcement as a parameter (see US-C01-client).

cases.case: Reception activated for each Distribution Session listed in the USD using its Session Description
cases.what: Every Distribution Session of the service is activated in turn, each from its own Session Description, bundled or fetched from its locator.

cases.case: Deactivation by external service identifier stops reception of every Distribution Session
cases.what: Deactivation looks the service up by external service identifier and stops reception of each of its Distribution Sessions.

cases.case: Reception not activated outside the announced schedule windows
cases.what: Activation is refused unless the current time falls in a start/stop window or a repetition-rule occurrence of a schedule entry; a service with no schedule is not gated.

cases.case: A schedule instance marked cancelled is not joined
cases.what: A cancelled schedule instance never grants activation, even inside its own window.
cases.locator: TS 26.517 V18.6.0 clause 5.2.7, table 5.2.7-1, row cancelled

cases.case: A cancelled mark received for an ongoing instance terminates its procedures (reception, repair)
cases.what: An updated announcement marking an active instance cancelled only replaces the stored service; reception and repair already running are not stopped.
cases.locator: TS 26.517 V18.6.0 clause 5.2.7, table 5.2.7-1, row cancelled

cases.case: Schedule entry with the highest version takes priority
cases.what: Among schedule entries with the same id, only the one with the highest version is considered.

cases.case: Schedule takes precedence over SDP t/r lines
cases.what: Only the schedule gates activation; the SDP t= line is parsed but not used for any decision.

noted: The schedule is checked only at activation; reception is not stopped when the window ends.
A schedule entry with neither start/stop nor repetitionRule lets activation through.
Reception started from the pre-configuration, the configured announcement-channel fallback and the manual-activate endpoint is not checked against any schedule.
The cancelled property is read although the TS 26.517 announcement schema copy the build pins (version 2.1.0) does not define it; the client's parser is hand-written, not generated.

requirements.name: Session Description handling

cases.case: SDP read per RFC 8866, as far as the code does
cases.what: The SDP is read line by line (CRLF or LF), session-level values are inherited by each FLUTE media section, and a media section without a usable connection address is dropped; the document is not otherwise validated.

cases.case: mbs-servicetype attribute (broadcast/multicast and decimal TMGI) read
cases.what: The attribute is parsed at session or media level into the service type and the decimal TMGI and is reported when reception starts; reception itself does not depend on it.

cases.case: flute-tsi, source-filter, c= multicast address and m= port used to join
cases.what: The TSI, the source of an incl source-filter (for a source-specific join), the c= address without its TTL suffix and the m= port are passed to the FLUTE receiver for each FLUTE media section.

cases.case: FLUTE/UDP protocol recognised
cases.what: Only m= lines whose protocol is FLUTE/UDP start a FLUTE session description; other media sections are skipped.

cases.case: Packet Distribution Method Session Description (proxy / forward-only) handled
cases.what: No code reads a Packet Distribution Method Session Description; such sessions are refused before their SDP is read.

cases.case: distributionMethod OBJECT routed to object (FLUTE) reception
cases.what: A Distribution Session with distributionMethod OBJECT is received with FLUTE.

cases.case: distributionMethod PACKET routed to packet reception
cases.what: A PACKET Distribution Session is refused with a warning; the packet reception class is an empty placeholder.

noted: a=FEC-redundancy-level is parsed but not used, and a=FEC-declaration is not parsed.
The rule that mbs-servicetype appears only once and at session level is not checked.
A Session Description that is not bundled is fetched with a plain GET that carries no User-Agent.

requirements.name: Post-session object repair (MBS-4-UC)

cases.case: Client supports post-session repair when the USD provides Object Repair parameters
cases.what: When postSessionObjectRepairParameters is present, each object reception carries them and incomplete objects are passed to the repair procedure; without them no repair is attempted.

cases.case: End of session identified (FDT @Expires, A-flag, or schedule end)
cases.what: Repair starts only from FLUTE close signals (session close, and also object close); FDT @Expires and the end of the schedule window are not used to detect the end of the session.

cases.case: Repair URL chosen randomly from objectRepairBaseLocators (once, for the session)
cases.what: A repair URL is drawn uniformly at random from the list, but anew for every incomplete object rather than once in step 3 for all objects of the session.

cases.case: Repair location, case 1: no repair base URL
cases.what: File@Content-Location is used unchanged.

cases.case: Repair location, case 2: repair base URL without distribution base URL
cases.what: Only the scheme and authority of the repair base URL replace those of File@Content-Location; any path in the repair base URL is dropped.

cases.case: Repair location, case 3: both repair and distribution base URLs
cases.what: The distribution base URL prefix of File@Content-Location is replaced with the repair base URL.

cases.case: .gz appended for Content-Encoding gzip, with byte ranges only if File-ETag is present
cases.what: For File@Content-Encoding gzip the extension is inserted before any query part, and the whole object is requested when the object has no File-ETag.

cases.case: Byte ranges computed per listing 6.2.4.5-1 (ESIs to ranges, last range clipped to F)
cases.what: The listing is transcribed: consecutive ESIs extend a range by T, others start a new range at ESI*T, and only the last range end is clipped to the content length.

cases.case: Back-off parameters accepted with either offsetTime or randomTimePeriod absent (absent = zero)
cases.what: Both offsetTime and randomTimePeriod are required when backOffParameters is present; a document omitting either is rejected as a whole.

cases.case: Back-off = offsetTime + RandomTime, RandomTime uniform in [0, randomTimePeriod] (TS 26.346 clause 9.3.4)
cases.what: The back-off is offsetTime plus a uniformly drawn fraction of randomTimePeriod, truncated to whole seconds.

cases.case: No repair request before the back-off has elapsed
cases.what: The repair thread waits the computed back-off before sending its first request.

cases.case: Whole object with a plain GET when M=1 covering 0..F
cases.what: A single range covering the whole object is requested without a Range header and 200 is expected.

cases.case: Partial GET with a Range header for a subset
cases.what: Any other range is requested with a Range header (inclusive end) and 206 is expected.

cases.case: Multiple ranges in one request, headers not exceeding 2048 bytes, split into as few requests as possible
cases.what: Each range is requested in its own GET, so M>1 ranges produce M requests and no multi-range request or header-size split is made.

cases.case: If-Match or If-Range carrying the entity tag when available
cases.what: When the FDT gives a File-ETag, it is sent in an If-Match header.

cases.case: One HTTP session per Distribution Session
cases.what: Every repair request opens and closes its own HTTP client handle, so requests for one Distribution Session do not share one HTTP session.

cases.case: Separate GET per damaged object
cases.what: Each incomplete object is repaired on its own with requests for that object's location only.

cases.case: User-Agent with product identifier MBSTFClient at MBS-4-UC
cases.what: Repair requests set no User-Agent header.

cases.case: Recovered object made available to the MBS-Aware Application (6.2.4.6 step 4)
cases.what: The recovered bytes are handed back to the FLUTE file object and, once it reports complete, the object is stored and served over the local API like any received object.

noted: Repair is also started when a single object is closed during the session; TS 26.346 V18.2.0 clause 9.3.2 lets a client start on an end-of-object flag, while TS 26.517 clause 6.2.4.3 leaves in-session repair for future study.
Clause 6.2.3.1 forbids repair with OBJECT_STREAMING; the USD gives the client no operating mode, and the client repairs whenever repair parameters are present.
A running back-off is not reset when an updated announcement changes the repair parameters (TS 26.346 clause 9.3.4.4).
objectRepairBaseLocator (Annex A.2 schema, scalar) and objectRepairBaseLocators (table 5.2.8-1, array) are both accepted, as string or array.

requirements.name: MBS Service Key retrieval from the MBSSF (MBS-10)

cases.case: Retrieval triggered by presence of SecurityDescription
cases.what: A Distribution Session carrying a SecurityDescription is refused at activation, because the shipped client never creates its MBSSF client component; no MBS-10 exchange takes place.

cases.case: Endpoint chosen from mBSSFAddresses and kept for the User Service Session
cases.what: No endpoint is chosen, because the shipped client never creates its MBSSF client component; that component would use the first listed endpoint for every request.

cases.case: Another endpoint chosen after repeated non-response
cases.what: A request that gets no answer is not retried, and nothing switches to another listed endpoint; the switching function exists but nothing calls it.

cases.case: Back-off per backOffParameters before the first MSK request
cases.what: The MSK request is sent straight after registration with no back-off wait.

cases.case: Back-off parameters accepted with either offsetTime or randomTimePeriod absent
cases.what: Both values are required when backOffParameters is present, so a SecurityDescription giving only one of them causes the whole document to be rejected.

cases.case: MSK request sent as HTTP POST listing Key Domain ID - MSK ID pairs (TS 33.246 clause 6.3.2.2.1, Annex G.2.3)
cases.what: No MSK request is sent, because the shipped client never creates its MBSSF client component; that component would post a TS 33.246 MSK request listing one Key Domain ID and MSK ID pair.

cases.case: MSK delivered to the client (TS 33.246 clause 6.3.2.3.1) and used to enable reception
cases.what: No code receives a pushed MSK, so a protected Distribution Session is never enabled even after a successful MSK request.

cases.case: User-Agent with product identifier MBSFClient at MBS-10
cases.what: No MBS-10 request is sent, because the shipped client never creates its MBSSF client component; that component would send User-Agent MBSFClient/18.6.0.

cases.case: uICCKeyManagement and 2GGBAallowed acted on
cases.what: Both flags are read from the announcement and echoed back in the service listing, but nothing uses them.

requirements.exists: An MBSSF client component that chooses the first listed endpoint, posts an MSK request per TS 33.246 and sends User-Agent MBSFClient/18.6.0 exists but is not instantiated by the client.
noted: Table 5.2.10-1 names the key identifiers mSKId/mSKDomainId while the Annex A.2 schema names them mBSId/mBSDomainId (and lists mBSSessionKeyInfo as required for a property defined as mBSServiceKeyInfo); the client reads mBSServiceKeyInfo with mBSId/mBSDomainId.
The identifier strings are used as raw bytes and base64-encoded in the MSK request; their lengths (3 and 4 bytes, TS 33.246 clause 6.3.2.1) are not checked and no clause states the string encoding.
Annex G.2.3 requires HTTP/1.1; the MBS-10 requests do not set the HTTP version, leaving it to the HTTP library default.

requirements.name: Delivery to the MBS-Aware Application (MBS-7)

cases.case: Received objects exposed to the application by their distribution URL
cases.what: Each complete object is stored under the path of its FDT Content-Location and served on the local API at that same path, with its content type.

cases.case: Application Service Entry Point (e.g. DASH MPD) offered to the application
cases.what: The service listing includes each Distribution Session's entryPointLocator and content type, and an entry point document delivered as an object is served at its path.

cases.case: Unified DASH manifest used, keeping Representations available via unicast
cases.what: The served MPD drops every Representation for which no segment is held locally, so Representations meant for unicast retrieval disappear from the manifest the application receives.

cases.case: Packet Distribution Method proxy mode: UDP payloads made available to the application
cases.what: Packet Distribution Sessions are refused and the packet reception class is an empty placeholder.

cases.case: Object not served before it is fully received
cases.what: Only objects the FLUTE receiver reports complete, or that repair completes, are stored and served.

cases.case: Object no longer served after its availability end time (Cache-Control@Expires)
cases.what: Objects whose Cache-Control@Expires time has passed are dropped from the store whenever a new object is stored.

noted: TS 26.502 V18.6.0 clause 4.4.1 defines MBS-6 and MBS-7 as APIs exposed by the MBSF Client and MBSTF Client, but neither TS 26.502 nor TS 26.517 V18.6.0 specifies these APIs; the local HTTP API (/services, /services/activate, /services/deactivate, /content/...) is this project's own, judged here only against the procedure steps.

MPD rewriting (no TS 26.502 or TS 26.517 clause governs it): when serving a .mpd, the client rebuilds each $Number$ SegmentTimeline from the segments it holds, extends a uniform-duration timeline past its last entry over held segments, advertises the newest contiguous run of at least min_run_segments (default 3) or else the longest, and sets startNumber to match; the code cites ISO/IEC 23009-1 clause 5.3.9.5.3 for this.
Objects are evicted least-recently-used once the store exceeds max_stored_objects (default 500), an operator setting with no clause behind it.
Project extensions outside MBS-7: PUT /content/... stores a body as if received, and x-5gmag-reception-config / x-5gmag-ue-pre-configuration read and change client settings.
The most recent announcement bundle and its parts are exposed at /service-announcement.

cases.case: Baseline profile assumed when conformanceProfiles is absent
cases.what: A Distribution Session without conformanceProfiles passes the profile check.

cases.case: A session listing only profiles the client does not support is not processed
cases.what: Activation is refused when the listed profiles do not include the Baseline profile, the only one the client recognises.

cases.case: urn:3GPP:26517:17:baseline recognised
cases.what: The Baseline URI is matched exactly against the listed profiles.

cases.case: Client meets the Baseline profile's client requirements (Object and Packet Distribution Methods)
cases.what: The client accepts Baseline sessions but supports only the Object Distribution Method; Packet Distribution Sessions are refused.

requirements.name: MBS Client functions (TS 26.502 clause 4.3.5)

cases.case: Acquisition of User Service Announcements from MBS-5 and/or MBS-4-MC
cases.what: Announcements are acquired from the MBS-4-MC announcement channel and by MBS-5 discovery by service class; retrieval by identifier and other gaps are judged in US-C01-client.

cases.case: Authorisation of access to protected MBS data via MBS-10
cases.what: Protected Distribution Sessions are refused instead of authorised (see US-C05-client).

cases.case: Reception of MBS data via MBS-4-MC from a Multicast or Broadcast MBS Session
cases.what: Object Distribution Method data is received with FLUTE whatever the service type; Packet Distribution Method data is not received (see US-C03-client).

cases.case: Exposure of MBS Application Data Sessions towards the MBS-Aware Application
cases.what: Received objects and entry points are exposed on the local API, but packet payloads are not and the unified manifest loses unicast Representations (see US-C06-client).

cases.case: Unicast recovery via MBS-4-UC if unicast repair is provisioned
cases.what: Post-session repair runs when repair parameters are provisioned, with the differences listed in US-C04-client (end-of-session detection, per-object URL choice, one request per range, separate connections, no User-Agent).

noted: AL-FEC (bullet 'Using AL-FEC to recover packets or objects'): the client passes each FLUTE session to rt-libflute, which takes the FEC scheme from each object's FEC OTI; the client itself only parses a=FEC-redundancy-level, without using it. Left out as resting on rt-libflute.

features.name: MBS-Aware Application
features.summary: The dashboard activates and deactivates MBS User Services by external service identifier through the MBS Client, shows the announced names and service class, and plays the received content; it cannot pass a full announcement received by application-private means. TS 26.502 defines no API at MBS-6 or MBS-7, so only the procedure steps are judged.

requirements.name: Use of the MBS Client by the MBS-Aware Application (MBS-6, MBS-7)

cases.case: Activation by external service identifier (MBS-6)
cases.what: The Play link calls the MBS Client's activate operation with the first external service identifier of the chosen service.

cases.case: Activation passing a full MBS User Service Announcement (MBS-8 route)
cases.what: The dashboard has no way to receive an announcement from the Application Provider or to pass one to the MBS Client.

cases.case: Deactivation by external service identifier (MBS-6)
cases.what: The Deactivate link calls the MBS Client's deactivate operation with the service's first external service identifier.

cases.case: Application-facing parameters (service class, names) shown from the announcement
cases.what: Each announced service is shown with its names, service class, language, distribution method, session count and entry point, as listed by the MBS Client.

cases.case: Selection of an announced service
cases.what: The user picks a service from the list the MBS Client reports, and that choice drives the activation call.

cases.case: Receives data from the MBSTF Client (MBS-7) as an MBS Application Data Session
cases.what: Received objects are fetched from the MBS Client's content endpoint and passed to a DASH or HLS player; the object cache is also listed.

noted: MBS-6 and MBS-7 have no specified API: TS 26.502 V18.6.0 clause 4.3.6 says the MBS-Aware Application 'is not defined within the present document', and TS 26.517 V18.6.0 defines APIs only at MBS-1, MBS-5 and the internal MBS7' (User Service Description retrieval). The calls checked here are the MBS Client's own local API, so verdicts cover only whether the step is done, not its form.
Activation and deactivation are sent as GET requests that change state; no clause governs the method because MBS-6 is unspecified.
Before handing a DASH MPD to the player, the dashboard removes Representations whose initialisation segment is not in the client's cache. No clause governs this.
The dashboard can ask the MBS Client for services of a given service class, and shows the last received User Service Descriptions bundle.

features.name: TMGI allocation
features.summary: The MB-SMF allocates, refreshes and deallocates TMGIs over Nmbsmf_TMGI with the response codes and causes TS 29.532 defines, and the MB-SMF client library sends and reads all three requests; the MBSF itself never calls this service and obtains its TMGIs through MBS session creation instead.

requirements.name: Nmbsmf_TMGI Allocate (POST /tmgi)

cases.case: Allocate tmgiNumber TMGIs
cases.what: Allocates the requested number of TMGIs and answers 200 OK with a TmgiAllocated body listing them and a single expiration time for all of them.

cases.case: Refresh the expiration time of a tmgiList
cases.what: Sets a new expiration time on every listed TMGI and returns them in tmgiList with that one expiration time.

cases.case: tmgiNumber not valid: 403 MANDATORY_IE_INCORRECT
cases.what: A tmgiNumber below 1 or above the smaller of 255 and the configured TMGI ceiling is answered 403 Forbidden with cause MANDATORY_IE_INCORRECT.

cases.case: TMGI to refresh not found: 404 UNKNOWN_TMGI
cases.what: A refresh naming a TMGI the MB-SMF does not hold is answered 404 Not Found with cause UNKNOWN_TMGI, before anything is changed.

cases.case: TMGI to refresh expired: 404 UNKNOWN_TMGI
cases.what: An expired TMGI that the MB-SMF still holds is refreshed and returned with a new expiration time instead of being answered 404 UNKNOWN_TMGI; expired TMGIs are only reclaimed when an allocation would exceed the TMGI ceiling, and the lookup does not check the expiration time.

cases.case: Request with neither tmgiNumber nor tmgiList
cases.what: Answered 400 Bad Request with cause MANDATORY_IE_MISSING, since the request body carries nothing to allocate or refresh.

noted: The MBS Service ID of a new TMGI is a random 24-bit value; the code does not check it against TMGIs already allocated, so two allocations can collide.
The PLMN of every allocated TMGI is the PLMN of the last TAI in the MB-SMF configuration, and the NID attribute is never set.

The expiration time is a fixed validity period set at build time, not an operator option; expired TMGIs are reclaimed only when the TMGI ceiling is reached, and a request that cannot be met at that moment is answered 500 with cause INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES.
Redirection (307, 308) is not produced; TS 29.532 notes it is inserted by an SCP.

requirements.name: Nmbsmf_TMGI Deallocate (DELETE /tmgi)

spec.locator: clause 5.2.2.3.1 steps 1 and 2a; Table 6.1.3.2.3.2-1 and -3; TS29532_Nmbsmf_TMGI.yaml, DELETE /tmgi

cases.case: Deallocate the TMGIs in tmgi-list: 204
cases.what: Removes every listed TMGI and answers 204 No Content with no body.

cases.case: TMGI not found: 404 UNKNOWN_TMGI
cases.what: A listed TMGI the MB-SMF does not hold is answered 404 Not Found with cause UNKNOWN_TMGI, and none of the list is removed.

cases.case: tmgi-list absent
cases.what: A DELETE without tmgi-list is answered 400 Bad Request with cause MANDATORY_QUERY_PARAM_MISSING, following the M presence in Table 6.1.3.2.3.2-1; the OpenAPI file does not mark the parameter required, and a request without it indicates no TMGI, which the prose requires.

noted: A TMGI still used by a live MBS session is not freed; the request is answered 403 with no cause, a case TS 29.532 does not cover.

Table 6.1.3.2.3.2-1 gives tmgi-list presence M while TS29532_Nmbsmf_TMGI.yaml does not mark it required; Annex A takes precedence on encoding, and rejecting the request satisfies both because the prose requires the query parameter to carry the TMGIs.

requirements.name: MB-SMF client: Nmbsmf_TMGI requests

cases.case: Allocate request (POST /tmgi with tmgiNumber)
cases.what: Discovers the MB-SMF through the NRF by service name and sends a TmgiAllocate body with tmgiNumber set to the count of TMGIs wanted.

cases.case: Refresh request (POST /tmgi with tmgiList)
cases.what: Sends the TMGIs to refresh in tmgiList, alone or with tmgiNumber in the same request.

cases.case: Read the 200 TmgiAllocated response
cases.what: Requires a non-empty tmgiList, applies the one expiration time to each returned TMGI and reports each to the caller; an error response is reported for each TMGI that was being refreshed.

cases.case: Deallocate request (DELETE /tmgi with tmgi-list)
cases.what: Sends the TMGIs as a JSON array in the tmgi-list query parameter and reports success or the ProblemDetails for each TMGI on the response.

noted: An MNC is kept as a number and its length is derived from its value, so a three-digit MNC below 100 (for example 001) is sent back as a two-digit MNC.
A TMGI request that times out is not reported to the caller: the timeout handler returns before reaching the TMGI case when the transaction has no MBS session.
A new-TMGI allocation that fails is not reported to the caller; only TMGIs being refreshed get the error.

features.name: MBS session creation
features.summary: The MB-SMF creates broadcast and multicast MBS sessions with a TMGI it allocates or one supplied, reserves the MB-UPF ingress tunnel and answers 201 with a Location header; it does not return the MBS FSA IDs, ignores the status subscription carried in the request, continues with the requested rather than the reduced service area, mis-reads cell lists, supports only one area per location dependent session, and has none of the Release 18 RedCap or associated-session inputs.

requirements.name: Nmbsmf_MBSSession Create (POST /mbs-sessions)

spec.locator: clause 5.3.2.2.1 steps 1 and 2a; Table 6.2.3.2.3.1-3; TS29532_Nmbsmf_MBSSession.yaml, POST /mbs-sessions

cases.case: 201 Created with Location header
cases.what: After the MB-UPF accepts the PFCP session, answers 201 Created with an absolute Location URI ending in the new mbsSessionRef and a CreateRspData body.

cases.case: tmgiAllocReq: TMGI allocated and returned with its expiration time
cases.what: Allocates a TMGI for the session and returns it with its expiration time in the response.

cases.case: Previously allocated TMGI as MBS Session ID; unknown TMGI: 404 UNKNOWN_TMGI
cases.what: Looks the supplied TMGI up among those allocated and answers 404 Not Found with cause UNKNOWN_TMGI when it is not there.

cases.case: SSM as MBS Session ID without tmgiAllocReq: MB-SMF allocates a TMGI
cases.what: A multicast session identified by an SSM must also carry an existing TMGI or tmgiAllocReq, and is otherwise answered 400; TS 23.247 has the MB-SMF allocate a TMGI whenever an SSM is the MBS Session ID.

cases.case: ingressTunAddrReq: MB-UPF ingress tunnel returned
cases.what: Asks the MB-UPF to choose an ingress tunnel and returns its address and port in ingressTunAddr.

cases.case: MBS FSA IDs returned for a broadcast session
cases.what: The MBS FSA IDs received are kept and sent to NG-RAN but are left out of the Create response.

cases.case: MBS FSA IDs selected from local configuration when none received
cases.what: No MBS FSA ID configuration exists; a broadcast session created without FSA IDs has none.

cases.case: MBS service area: TAI list
cases.what: Parses each TAI of mbsServiceArea and stores it with the session.

cases.case: MBS service area: NCGI list
cases.what: The cells of an NCGI-TAI entry are not read correctly, so the cells stored for the session are not the cells requested.

cases.case: Reduced service area reported in redMbsServArea
cases.what: When the configured MB-SMF service area does not cover every requested TAI, returns the covered TAIs in redMbsServArea.

cases.case: Create continues with the reduced service area
cases.what: The reduced area is only reported; the MB-UPF and AMF are set up with the full area that was requested.

cases.case: Location dependent session: Area Session ID allocated per MBS service area
cases.what: Sets areaSessionId to 1 for every location dependent session, and rejects a second Create for another area of the same TMGI as already created, so a session cannot have more than one area.

cases.case: Session already created: 403 MBS_SESSION_ALREADY_CREATED
cases.what: A Create for an MBS Session ID already in use is answered 403 Forbidden with cause MBS_SESSION_ALREADY_CREATED.

cases.case: Overlapping service area: 403 OVERLAPPING_MBS_SERVICE_AREA
cases.what: An overlap with another session of the same identifier is answered with cause MBS_SESSION_ALREADY_CREATED; OVERLAPPING_MBS_SERVICE_AREA is never sent.

cases.case: MBS service information: QoS derived locally
cases.what: Takes the 5QI of each media component in mbsServInfo as one MBS QoS flow, with a single 5QI 9 flow when none is given.

cases.case: Multicast session activity status
cases.what: Stores activityStatus for a multicast session and echoes it in the response.

cases.case: Status subscription in the Create request
cases.what: mbsSessionSubsc is not read, no subscription is created and the response carries none.

cases.case: NR RedCap UE information and Associated Session ID
cases.what: Neither attribute exists in the request model the MB-SMF is built against, so neither is read or passed on.

cases.case: NRF profile updated with the SSM MBS Session ID
cases.what: The MB-SMF profile at the NRF is not updated when an SSM is the MBS Session ID.

noted: A geographic area in extMbsServiceArea is stored as a point at latitude 0, longitude 0, whatever was sent; TS 23.247 has the NEF or MBSF translate such areas before the MB-SMF.
The Allocation and Retention Priority sent to NG-RAN is fixed for every flow, since the MBS QoS request carries none.
anyUeInd and the multicast security context are not read.
mbsSessionRef is the index of the session in a fixed-size pool, so references are reused after a session is released.

features.name: MBS session update and release
features.summary: Release works end to end, the MB-SMF tearing down the MB-UPF session and the AMF context, and an Update can switch a multicast session between active and inactive; no other modifiable field can be updated, two of them are refused as malformed, and status subscriptions and notifications towards the MBSF, NEF or AF do not exist.

requirements.name: Nmbsmf_MBSSession Update (PATCH /mbs-sessions/{mbsSessionRef})

cases.case: Successful update: 204 No Content
cases.what: Applies the patch and answers 204 No Content.

cases.case: Unknown mbsSessionRef: 404 UNKNOWN_MBS_SESSION
cases.what: A PATCH or DELETE on a reference that names no live session is answered 404 Not Found with cause UNKNOWN_MBS_SESSION.

cases.case: Multicast: session activity status
cases.what: Replaces the stored activityStatus of a multicast session and refuses the field for a broadcast session with 403 MODIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED.

cases.case: MBS service area
cases.what: A patch to mbsServiceArea or extMbsServiceArea, or to any entry of their lists, is answered 501 Not Implemented.

cases.case: MBS service information
cases.what: A patch to mbsServInfo or any of its members is answered 501 Not Implemented.

cases.case: Reduced service area on update: 200 with redMbsServArea
cases.what: The service area cannot be updated, so no reduced area is ever derived from an area received in an update. The 200 response with redMbsServArea is instead sent for any accepted update of a session whose Create-time area was reduced, whatever the update changed.

cases.case: Multicast: security context
cases.what: A patch to mbsSecurityContext is answered 501 Not Implemented; the MB-SMF keeps no multicast security context.

cases.case: Broadcast: list of MBS FSA IDs
cases.what: A patch to mbsFsaIdList matches no known path and is answered 400 Bad Request as malformed, although the clause lists it as modifiable.

cases.case: Broadcast: NR RedCap UE information
cases.what: The attribute does not exist in the model the MB-SMF is built against.

cases.case: contactPcfInd
cases.what: A patch to contactPcfInd matches no known path and is answered 400 Bad Request as malformed.

cases.case: Fields the clause does not list as modifiable
cases.what: A patch to the session identifier, TMGI, service type, SSM, DNN, S-NSSAI, times, subscription or anyUeInd is answered 403 Forbidden with cause MODIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED.

noted: A change of activityStatus is only stored; no activation or deactivation towards the MB-UPF, AMF or NG-RAN follows it.
Patches are applied one by one as they are checked, so a request whose later item is refused can leave an earlier activityStatus change in place.
An accepted update of a session whose service area was reduced at creation is answered 200 with redMbsServArea instead of 204, even when the request carries no service area.

requirements.name: Nmbsmf_MBSSession Release (DELETE /mbs-sessions/{mbsSessionRef})

spec.locator: clause 5.3.2.4.1 steps 1 and 2a; TS 23.247 V18.8.0 clause 7.3.2 step 3; TS29532_Nmbsmf_MBSSession.yaml, DELETE /mbs-sessions/{mbsSessionRef}

cases.case: Release answered 204 No Content
cases.what: Answers 204 No Content once the release towards the AMF and MB-UPF has been started.

cases.case: Ingress resources released at the MB-UPF
cases.what: Sends a PFCP Session Deletion Request for the N4mb session and frees the session when the MB-UPF answers, or at once when no PFCP session was ever set up.

cases.case: Broadcast: Namf_MBSBroadcast ContextRelease to the AMF
cases.what: For a session that has an AMF context, sends DELETE on the stored mbsContextRef to the AMF.

noted: A repeated Release of a session already being released is answered 204 without acting again.
A TMGI the MB-SMF allocated for the session in the Create request is freed with the session.

requirements.name: Nmbsmf_MBSSession StatusSubscribe, StatusUnsubscribe and StatusNotify (MB-SMF)

spec.locator: clauses 5.3.2.6, 5.3.2.7 and 5.3.2.8; TS 23.247 V18.8.0 clause 7.3.5; TS29532_Nmbsmf_MBSSession.yaml, /mbs-sessions/subscriptions

cases.case: Create subscription (POST /mbs-sessions/subscriptions)
cases.what: The path is taken as a session reference that does not exist and answered 404 UNKNOWN_MBS_SESSION.

cases.case: Update subscription (PATCH /mbs-sessions/subscriptions/{subscriptionId})
cases.what: Answered 404 UNKNOWN_MBS_SESSION; no subscription resource exists.

cases.case: Delete subscription (DELETE /mbs-sessions/subscriptions/{subscriptionId})
cases.what: Answered 404 UNKNOWN_MBS_SESSION; no subscription resource exists.

cases.case: StatusNotify: broadcast delivery status (STARTED, TERMINATED)
cases.what: The MB-SMF sends no notification when a broadcast session starts or ends.

cases.case: StatusNotify: ingress tunnel added or changed
cases.what: The MB-SMF sends no notification when the ingress tunnel changes.

requirements.exists: The path dispatcher and the MBSF-side client already have the request shapes; the MB-SMF has no subscription store.

requirements.name: Nmbsmf_MBSSession optional features MOCNS and REDCAP

cases.case: MOCNS (associatedSessionId to NG-RAN)
cases.what: Not supported or advertised; the feature is optional.

cases.case: REDCAP (NrRedCapUeInfo to NG-RAN)
cases.what: Not supported or advertised; the feature is optional.

features.name: MB-UPF user plane (N4mb, N6mb, Nmb9, N3mb)
features.summary: The MB-SMF sets up one PFCP session per MBS session on N4mb with the MBS Session Identifier and the PLLSSM and JMBSSM flags, and the MB-UPF opens a UDP ingress tunnel for Nmb9 or N6mb and forwards over N3mb to a lower-layer SSM with a common TEID it allocates; only one QoS flow is set up whatever the session carries, the QFI sequence number is never inserted, the JMBSSM flag is not acted on, the Area Session ID is not sent, and unicast N3mb (MBSU, PFCP Session Modification) does not exist.

requirements.name: N4mb PFCP Session Establishment (MB-SMF)

cases.case: PFCP Session Establishment Request on MBS session creation
cases.what: Selects an MB-UPF among the associated PFCP peers and sends a PFCP Session Establishment Request with its own F-SEID when the Create request is accepted.

cases.case: MBS Session Identifier in MBS Session N4mb Control Information
cases.what: Carries the TMGI, or the SSM for an SSM-identified session, as the MBS Session Identifier inside MBS Session N4mb Control Information.

cases.case: Area Session ID for a location dependent session
cases.what: No Area Session ID is sent, so a location dependent session is set up on N4mb like any other session.

cases.case: JMBSSM when N6mb uses multicast transport
cases.what: Sets JMBSSM when no ingress tunnel is requested and an SSM is known, and puts that SSM in the IP Multicast Addressing Info of the downlink PDR.

cases.case: PLLSSM for N3mb multicast transport
cases.what: Always sets PLLSSM and reads the lower-layer SSM and C-TEID from the Multicast Transport Information the MB-UPF returns.

cases.case: C-TEID signalled to NG-RAN equals the C-TEID in the GTP-U header
cases.what: The MB-SMF stores the C-TEID of the Multicast Transport Information without converting it from network byte order and then encodes that stored value as the GTP-TEID towards NG-RAN, while the MB-UPF puts its own C-TEID in the GTP-U header. On a little-endian host the TEID NG-RAN is told is the byte-reversed form of the TEID it receives. Code-derived, not run.

cases.case: Local Ingress Tunnel with CHOOSE for Nmb9 or unicast N6mb
cases.what: When an ingress tunnel is requested, sends a Create Traffic Endpoint with a Local Ingress Tunnel asking the MB-UPF to choose an IPv4 address and port, and reads the chosen tunnel from the Created Traffic Endpoint.

cases.case: One PDR, QER and FAR per MBS QoS flow
cases.what: Creates a single downlink PDR, FAR and QER with QFI 1 for every session, while the QoS flows sent to NG-RAN follow the media components requested, so a session with more than one flow is not set up per flow.

cases.case: IQFISN set in the Create QER
cases.what: The QER Indications IE is not sent, so IQFISN is never set.

cases.case: FAR with Apply Action FSSM and MBS Multicast Parameters
cases.what: Creates the downlink FAR with Apply Action FSSM and an MBS Multicast Parameters IE whose Outer Header Creation requests the lower-layer SSM and C-TEID.

cases.case: Separate PFCP session per MBS service area of a location dependent session
cases.what: One PFCP session is set up per MBS session, and a second area of the same session is refused before N4mb.

noted: The ingress tunnel is always requested as IPv4.
The MB-UPF is chosen round robin among associated PFCP peers; nothing MBS-specific guides the choice.
A PFCP rejection is answered to the Create caller with 500 and a cause mapped from the PFCP cause.

requirements.name: N4mb PFCP session at the MB-UPF

cases.case: Allocate an ingress tunnel on CHOOSE and return it
cases.what: Binds a UDP socket on the configured MBS tunnel address and next free port, or an ephemeral one, and returns it in the Created Traffic Endpoint; any failure rejects the session with a PFCP cause.

cases.case: PLLSSM: lower-layer SSM and C-TEID returned
cases.what: When PLLSSM is set, allocates a lower-layer SSM and returns it with the C-TEID in MBS Session N4mb Information, and uses that C-TEID on every FAR of the session.

cases.case: JMBSSM: join the SSM multicast tree
cases.what: The JMBSSM flag is stored but not read; the MB-UPF joins the SSM group only when the operator has enabled its multicast router option and no ingress tunnel was requested, for IPv4 only.

cases.case: FSSM: forward to the lower-layer SSM with the C-TEID
cases.what: Data received on the ingress tunnel, or matched to the session SSM on N6mb, is sent as GTP-U with the C-TEID and the QFI to the lower-layer SSM address.

cases.case: IQFISN: insert the DL MBS QFI Sequence Number
cases.what: No DL MBS QFI Sequence Number is ever inserted in the PDU Session Container.

cases.case: PFCP Session Deletion
cases.what: Answers the N4mb Session Deletion Request and frees the session, or answers Session context not found for an unknown SEID.

noted: A Local Ingress Tunnel with an explicit address (CHOOSE not set) is accepted but no socket is opened for it.
Usage reporting and Downlink Data Reports are not produced for MBS sessions.
The MBS session pool and the UDP tunnel ports have fixed sizes set by configuration.

requirements.name: N3mb unicast transport and N4mb Session Modification

spec.locator: clause 5.34.2.2; clause 5.34.2.1A; TS 23.247 V18.8.0 clause 7.3.1 step 8

cases.case: MB-SMF: N4mb Session Modification with MBSU and Add MBS Unicast Parameters
cases.what: No N4mb Session Modification is ever built, and an N3mb DL tunnel returned by NG-RAN through the AMF is not read.

cases.case: MB-UPF: forward and replicate to unicast DL tunnels
cases.what: The MB-UPF handles no N4mb Session Modification and no MBSU forwarding.

cases.case: Shared tunnel established towards the NG-RAN DL endpoint
cases.what: N3mb uses multicast transport only.

requirements.exists: The PFCP library already encodes and decodes the Add MBS Unicast Parameters IE and the MBSU flag.

features.name: Broadcast session start, update and release towards NG-RAN
features.summary: For a broadcast session the MB-SMF creates and releases an AMF broadcast context carrying the N2 SM information it builds (lower-layer SSM, C-TEID, QoS flows, FSA IDs), and the AMF sends Broadcast Session Setup, Modification and Release Requests and answers after the first NG-RAN response; the AMF sends to every connected gNB, can send cells the request never named, never reports completion in its first response, does not identify the NG-RAN in notifications, and does not handle Broadcast Session Release Response, Release Required or Transport, while the MB-SMF never sends ContextUpdate and ignores the N3mb tunnel information returned.

requirements.name: MB-SMF as Namf_MBSBroadcast consumer

spec.locator: clause 7.3.1 steps 2, 7, 8 and 11; clause 7.3.3 step 2; TS 29.518 V18.15.0 clause 5.6.2.2 step 1

cases.case: ContextCreate sent for a broadcast session only
cases.what: After answering the Create request, sends Namf_MBSBroadcast ContextCreate to an AMF found through the NRF when, and only when, the service type is broadcast.

cases.case: ContextCreate content: MBS Session ID, service area, N2 SM information, notifyUri, S-NSSAI
cases.what: Sends the TMGI, the requested TAIs and cells as mbsServiceArea (or as mbsServiceAreaInfoList with the Area Session ID for a location dependent session), the N2 SM information as a multipart NGAP part, its own notification URI and the first configured S-NSSAI.

cases.case: mbsContextRef taken from the 201 Location header
cases.what: Stores the context reference from the Location header of the 201 response to address the context later.

cases.case: N3mb DL tunnel information in the ContextCreate response or a later notification
cases.what: The n2MbsSmInfoList of the response and of notifications is not read, so a unicast N3mb tunnel offered by NG-RAN is never set up.

cases.case: Receive ContextStatusNotify: 204 No Content
cases.what: Accepts the notification on its callback URI, finds the session by TMGI and answers 204 No Content; the content is only logged.

cases.case: ContextUpdate on MBS Session Update for broadcast
cases.what: The MB-SMF never sends Namf_MBSBroadcast ContextUpdate.

cases.case: Associated Session ID in ContextCreate
cases.what: The request model has no associatedSessionId.

noted: ContextCreate goes to one AMF chosen by discovery, not to every AMF serving the area.
maxResponseTime is never sent.
Before ContextRelease the cached AMF instance is cleared so that the request goes through fresh discovery.

requirements.name: N2 SM information built by the MB-SMF (MBS Session Setup or Modification Request Transfer)

cases.case: MBS Session TNL Information 5GC: lower-layer SSM and C-TEID
cases.what: Carries the lower-layer multicast and source addresses returned by the MB-UPF, and a C-TEID, as Shared NG-U Multicast TNL Information; the value of the C-TEID is judged under SYS-N01, where it is found byte-reversed.

cases.case: MBS QoS Flows To Be Setup List
cases.what: One item per MBS QoS flow, with its QFI and 5QI and a fixed Allocation and Retention Priority.

cases.case: MBS Session FSA ID List
cases.what: Sent when FSA IDs were received, at most 64, and left out otherwise.

cases.case: NR RedCap UE information (Supported UE Type List)
cases.what: The transfer is encoded with the Release 17 ASN.1, which has no such IE.

noted: The location independent form of the TNL information is used for every session, location dependent ones included.

requirements.name: Namf_MBSBroadcast ContextCreate (AMF)

cases.case: Validate the request: missing mandatory IEs answered 400
cases.what: Rejects a request without n2MbsSmInfo and its NGAP part, mbsSessionId, notifyUri or snssai, or with both or neither of mbsServiceArea and mbsServiceAreaInfoList, with 400.

cases.case: One broadcast context per MBS session
cases.what: Removes a stored context with the same TMGI before creating the new one.

cases.case: BROADCAST SESSION SETUP REQUEST to the NG-RANs supporting MBS in the service area
cases.what: Sends the request to every connected gNB, whatever its tracking areas or MBS support.

cases.case: 201 Created with Location and MBS session identifier after the first successful NG-RAN response
cases.what: Holds the request until the first BROADCAST SESSION SETUP RESPONSE for the TMGI, then answers 201 Created with the mbsContextRef in Location and the mbsSessionId.

cases.case: Indication of completion in the 201 when all NG-RANs have responded
cases.what: The 201 never carries operationStatus, even when the only gNB has answered.

cases.case: N2 MBS Session Management containers in the 201
cases.what: The MBS Session Setup Response Transfer of the first response is not passed on.

cases.case: Failure only when all NG-RANs report failure
cases.what: The first BROADCAST SESSION SETUP FAILURE is answered to the MB-SMF as 500, even when other gNBs have not yet answered.

cases.case: Incompletion reported when maxResponseTime elapses
cases.what: maxResponseTime is not read and no timer is started, so a request no gNB answers stays pending.

noted: A location dependent request with more than one entry in mbsServiceAreaInfoList uses only the first entry.
With no gNB connected the request is never answered.

requirements.name: Namf_MBSBroadcast ContextUpdate and ContextRelease (AMF)

spec.locator: clauses 5.6.2.3 and 5.6.2.4; TS29518_Namf_MBSBroadcast.yaml, POST /mbs-contexts/{mbsContextRef}/update and DELETE /mbs-contexts/{mbsContextRef}

cases.case: ContextUpdate: service area and N2 container forwarded to NG-RAN
cases.what: Replaces the stored service area, takes the N2 container from the multipart body and sends a BROADCAST SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST to the connected gNBs; a request with neither is answered 400.

cases.case: ContextUpdate: notifyUri replaced
cases.what: A notifyUri in the request replaces the one stored for the context.

cases.case: ContextUpdate: 204 after the first NG-RAN response, 200 with N2 containers
cases.what: Always answers 204 No Content after the first response and never 200 with the response containers or the completion indication.

cases.case: ContextUpdate: ranIdList and noNgapSignallingInd (restoration)
cases.what: Neither is acted on.

cases.case: ContextUpdate on an unknown mbsContextRef: 404
cases.what: Answered 404 Not Found.

cases.case: ContextRelease: BROADCAST SESSION RELEASE REQUEST and 204
cases.what: Sends a BROADCAST SESSION RELEASE REQUEST to the connected gNBs, removes the context and answers 204 No Content; an unknown reference is answered 404.

noted: ContextRelease is answered before any NG-RAN has confirmed the release.
A POST on an individual context is taken as ContextUpdate whether or not the path ends in /update.

cases.case: Notification for NG-RAN responses after the first
cases.what: For each later Setup or Modification Response carrying a transfer, or the last one expected, posts a ContextStatusNotification with the TMGI and the transfer to the notification URI.

cases.case: NG-RAN node identifier in n2MbsSmInfoList
cases.what: The ranId of each container is left empty.

cases.case: operationStatus completion
cases.what: Sets MBS_SESSION_START_COMPLETE when all gNBs have answered, also when the operation was an update.

cases.case: Area Session ID for a location dependent session
cases.what: areaSessionId is never set.

cases.case: releasedInd when every NG-RAN asked for release
cases.what: Release Required is not handled, so no such notification is sent.

cases.case: BROADCAST SESSION SETUP REQUEST: MBS Session ID, S-NSSAI, MBS Service Area, transfer
cases.what: Encodes the TMGI, the requested S-NSSAI, the MBS Service Area (location independent, or location dependent with the Area Session ID) and the transfer from the MB-SMF.

cases.case: MBS Service Area content
cases.what: When the request names only TAIs, the cell list is filled with a cell identity made from each connected gNB identifier; when it names no TAI, the TAIs of the connected gNBs are used.

cases.case: Associated Session ID
cases.what: The IE is not in the Release 17 ASN.1 the AMF is built with.

cases.case: BROADCAST SESSION SETUP RESPONSE and FAILURE
cases.what: Correlates each by TMGI to the context and completes or fails the pending ContextCreate.

cases.case: BROADCAST SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST, RESPONSE and FAILURE
cases.what: Sends the MBS Session ID with the service area and transfer that changed, and correlates the answers to the pending ContextUpdate.

cases.case: BROADCAST SESSION RELEASE REQUEST
cases.what: Sends the MBS Session ID and a Cause.

cases.case: BROADCAST SESSION RELEASE RESPONSE: transfer passed to the MB-SMF
cases.what: The response is not dispatched and is only logged as not implemented.

cases.case: BROADCAST SESSION RELEASE REQUIRED
cases.what: The message is not dispatched, so the AMF never releases the session.

cases.case: BROADCAST SESSION TRANSPORT REQUEST, RESPONSE and FAILURE
cases.what: The procedure is not handled.

features.name: Multicast sessions
